label: Guide me: Tax rules

params.name: lede
params.default: The year's tax figures - slabs, rebates, caps and due dates - in one place. Everyone sees what every return uses; the portal owner fetches each year's, compares and applies.
params.label: lede

default.title: Live year
default.say: The figures every return on this portal uses today, and the year they are for. For everyone but the owner, this screen is read-only.

default.title: Which year
default.say: The next year, or this year again: the department publishes circulars all year, so a re-check can move a due date. A reminder shows when a re-check is due.

default.title: Fetch
default.say: Pick Gemini or OpenAI and fetch: it searches official sources and proposes every figure in the same shape. It uses the owner's own AI key.

default.title: At a glance
default.say: How many figures there are, how many changed, how many are the same, and how many are not announced yet.

default.title: Compare
default.say: Each figure side by side - the live year's and the new one's, what changed marked, and the source page for each.

default.title: Edit by hand
default.say: A figure the AI got wrong or could not find: type the right one. It is marked as edited.

default.title: Apply
default.say: Tick what is right, then apply. The figures go into the rules with History; last year's slabs stay for past years.

default.title: Changes it cannot apply
default.say: A new rule that is not a figure - a new fee, a new form - is listed here, to be built.

default.title: Sources
default.say: The pages the AI read, to check for yourself.

default.title: Rule book
default.say: Every rule {product} works by, written out in one book.

description_nl: 2026-10-06: the Tax rules walk; tours/sf-taxwatch.json is made from it. 2026-10-07: rewritten for what shipped on 6-7 October (tools/make_guides_wave4.py).
